title: Finite evaluation of ramified reduction balancing through image
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite extensions and $i:E\to F$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra map. Let $e\geq1$ satisfy $(t)\mathcal O_F=(v^e)$ for the specified uniformizers [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with compactification $c=(j,p)$, let $S,S'$ be respectively $E,F$ derived reduction-system calculi on $X$, let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\widehat{\mathcal O_E})$, and let $n\geq0$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Let $b_M=\operatorname{ramifiedImageBalancing}_M$ be image of reductionBalancing followed by inverse image reindexing and inverse native target supportModel [def-pur-strict-scalar-finite-evaluation-transport, def-pur-strict-scalar-reduction-balancing, def-pur-native-constant-support-model]. Let $\tau_M=\operatorname{targetEvaluation}_M$ [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data] and $\sigma_M=\operatorname{scalarImageEvaluation}_M$ [def-pur-strict-scalar-finite-evaluation-transport]. Then $\tau_M\circ e_n(b_M)=\sigma_M$. This is an equality of the prescribed coefficient, reindexing, and model isomorphisms; neither the geometric scalar mate nor finiteTensorMap occurs.

from.place: The finite evaluation calculation in strict compact-support scalar comparison, Step 7.

proof.text: Evaluate the universal whole-cochain counit equation of reductionBalancing on K-flat diagram representatives. Its ordinary map and finiteOrdinaryBalancing both send b tensor (1 tensor x) to the same quotient coefficient tensor (1 tensor x) at exponent e(n+1). The cochain equations of reductionEvaluation and tensorSquare identify the remaining reassociations; successive derived quotient normalization identifies their units. Universal counits therefore identify the local derived reduction isomorphisms.

Apply constant proper/open image. Naturality of evaluation and the identity ordinary selection squares carry reindexImage to the retained level e(n+1)-1. The right derived comparisons have the same unit normalization.

The identity-on-sections restriction square and normalized open unit identify supportModel followed by constant image evaluation with positiveSupportEvaluation and positiveImageRestriction. Cancel the model and reindex inverse pairs. The resulting left endpoint is targetEvaluation and the other side is scalarImageEvaluation. Localize the representative equality. Positive exponent arithmetic includes e=1,n=0 and no boundedness or equality-detection assumption is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem ramifiedImageBalancing_finiteEvaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (S' : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F X) (e : ℕ)
    (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    (ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) Y n).map
        ((ramifiedImageBalancing l E F i c S S' e he hepos).hom.app M) ≫
        (targetEvaluation l E F i c S' e he hepos n).hom.app M =
      (scalarImageEvaluation l E F i c S e he hepos n).hom.app M
